eyebrow: Trace 1: bit-flip code, X error on qubit 2, from |1⟩_L = |111⟩
code:
State after error:   111 -> 101
Measure Z1Z2:        1 vs 0 -> disagreement -> 1
Measure Z2Z3:        0 vs 1 -> disagreement -> 1
Syndrome:            (1,1) -> correction: flip qubit 2
Apply correction:    101 -> 111   (fully restored)
caption: Matches the Lesson 10 table exactly — the syndrome only ever depends on where the error hit, never on α or β.

eyebrow: Trace 2: phase-flip code, Z error on qubit 3, from |0⟩_L = |+++⟩
code:
State after error:   000 -> 001   (+ = 0, - = 1 shorthand)
Measure X1X2:        0 vs 0 -> agreement -> 0
Measure X2X3:        0 vs 1 -> disagreement -> 1
Syndrome:            (0,1) -> correction: apply Z to qubit 3
Apply correction:    001 -> 000   (fully restored)
caption: Matches the Lesson 11 table exactly — applying Z to qubit 3 flips it back from |−⟩ to |+⟩.
